name: benchmarketer
description: Open-source LLM benchmarking tool - CLI + Web Dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:cli"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @benchmarketer/shared && npm run build -w @benchmarketer/providers && npm run build -w @benchmarketer/api && npm run build -w @benchmarketer/dashboard && npm run build -w @benchmarketer/cli
